description: Fedora Linux aims to be on the leading edge of open-source technologies. It is the upstream source for Red Hat Enterprise Linux. PREBUILT OFFICIAL KASM IMAGE for the same distribution as the owner's ISO Fedora-Server-dvd-x86_64-42-1.1.iso (the ISO is the Server edition; this is the related desktop edition). It is not built from, extracted from or equivalent to that ISO: shared host kernel, no installer/bootloader/live-boot.
notes:
The Kasm Fedora 42 Workspace requires libseccomp => 2.5.3 to run.

This can be checked by running runc --version

If you still want to run Fedora 42 but do not have the minimum required libseccomp version, it can be run in an unsecure manner by adding: {"security_opt":["seccomp=unconfined"]} to the Docker Run Config Override (JSON) setting above.

NOTE: This will run the Workspace without the docker seccomp sandbox and will significantly reduce the amount of protection that Kasm Workspaces can provide.
